usedFor: Shopify knows when a shopper stalled at checkout, and Bird sends the message. An “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify can trigger “Send SMS” in Bird to the number the shopper entered, with the sender and message you set.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Send SMS” in Bird
bestTemplate.why: It is the only trigger here that carries a phone number, and a text to a shopper who left items behind is the obvious follow-up. “Send SMS” takes recipient, sender, message and category.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the text goes out after a scheduled check, not right away. In 50agents, anything that reaches someone outside the business waits for your approval.
